about: One entry per ticket. The Kanban on the canvas (page Kanban) and the handover read this file. States: later (one line, an idea), next (brainstormed, Milan's answer in, no board), now (board drawn and approved, waits for Go), progress (branch open), done (merged, with its version). Milan says the word; Claude moves the card. From 18 November 2026 a ticket can carry five parts: opportunity (why we act on it: where it comes from, the job the person was doing, what stood in the way as one of the kinds below, and why now), problem (the pain today, in plain words), story (what the person wants to be able to do and why, never the solution), ac (the acceptance criteria for what is new only: scenarios with an id, a short title that names the behaviour, and one sentence Given ..., when ..., then ...; one behaviour each), and unchanged (what already works and must not change: preconditions, not requirements). Kinds of what stood in the way: could not do it, a bug; could not do it, the feature is missing; too many steps; did not find it or did not understand it; a risk of a wrong tap; looks broken. The opportunity says honestly who saw it: a tester in a test, or Coach Milan's own look. Decided 18 November 2026, 12:41, for every ticket from the next one on (DT311 is the example): the Kanban card is short and names the ticket's board as a text label (no link); the board carries the weight. On the board, a vertical card holds the request (opportunity, problem, story) and then the solution and the decision; the screens are the design; a wide block at the bottom holds the agreement: the acceptance criteria as a table (#, Scenario, Given, When, Then), what already works and must not change, and design details for the build. A board is named by its ticket id, never by its file name. The full description is the Project note claude/chef-mealan-ticket-form.md and docs/ticket-form.md. A ticket can also carry findings (what was checked, with the date) and open (the open questions); both show on its board.

tickets.title: Correcting what Chef Mealan read: one edit mode for the foods, by hand or by words
tickets.why: Coach Milan 18 November 19:26, from the same test: the read gave a good list and asked about the chicken (he chose 200 g). The yogurt came as 10 % fat, fixed in the food list, not on the read's chip. Swap offered no 0.2 % fat yogurt. He added words (mayo was hidden; the yogurt is 0.2 % fat); the read then asked about the chicken again, this time whether it was 220 g. The list ended right, but it was confusing where and how to correct it. Four points: the kind of a food cannot be corrected on its chip; Swap lacks the variant; a second read asks again what was already answered, with another number; no one place to correct. Not reproduced and not drawn yet.

opportunity.from: Coach Milan, 18 November 2026, 19:26, from a photo he logged; and 21:48 with a screenshot of a tester's read.
opportunity.job: Make the list of foods right after a read, quickly, so the meal I log is the meal I ate.
opportunity.kind: Several doors, each doing part of the job: a tap on a chip, Change the foods, a swipe, a link to a form, and Chef Mealan's own question. None says which to use.
opportunity.why_now: Every read ends here. B150 changes the same screen, so both are tested once.

tickets.problem: After the read I got a nice list of foods. Chef Mealan asked about the chicken and I chose 200 g. The yogurt was fixed at 10% fat, which I saw only in the food list, not on the chip. I tried to swap it, but there was no 0.2% yogurt. So I told Chef Mealan: it was 0.2% yogurt, and there was mayo. He read again and asked about the chicken a second time, now 220 g. The list was right in the end, but where and how to correct it was confusing.
tickets.story: When a read is not quite right, I want one place to correct the foods, with my hands or with my words, so that I do not hunt for the right door and nothing I set is lost.

ac.title: The foods have one pencil
ac.text: Given Chef Mealan read a photo, when I look under the photo, then the foods have the small title Foods and one pencil, each chip shows the food's full name and grams, there is no Change the foods, and a tap on a chip does nothing.

ac.title: The pencil opens edit mode in place
ac.text: Given that read, when I tap the pencil, then under the photo I see Tell Chef Mealan what is wrong, one row per food with its full name, grams, Swap and Remove, and + Add a food, the pencil is an X, and a tap on the X shows the chips again.

ac.title: Grams, saved at once
ac.text: Given edit mode, when I type 200 in the chicken's grams, then the plate's numbers follow at once, there is no Done, and closed the chip says 200 g without the ~.

ac.title: Remove
ac.text: Given edit mode with a food that is wrong or there twice, when I tap Remove on its row, then the row is gone and the plate's numbers follow.

ac.title: Swap
ac.text: Given edit mode, when I tap Swap on the yogurt's row and pick a food in the swap list, then that food stands in the row with the same grams.

ac.title: Add a food
ac.text: Given edit mode, when I tap + Add a food and pick one, then it is a new row at its normal portion, and I am still in edit mode.

ac.title: By words
ac.text: Given edit mode, when I write The yogurt was 0.2% fat. There was mayo too. and tap Read again, then the rows show Yogurt, 0.2% fat and Mayonnaise, and one line from Chef Mealan says what he changed.

ac.title: What I set stays
ac.text: Given I chose 200 g for the chicken, by his question or by hand, when Chef Mealan reads again, then the chicken is still 200 g and he does not ask about it again; and a food I removed does not come back.

ac.title: His question stands on the read
ac.text: Given the read is not sure about one amount, when the read opens, then the question is under the chips with ~200 g, ~350 g and Neither, and a tap on an amount sets it and closes the question.

ac.title: Neither
ac.text: Given that question, when I tap Neither, then edit mode opens with that food's grams ready to type, and the question is gone.

ac.title: The old doors are gone

tickets.title: A dish is on the plate twice: whole amounts and a portion's amounts

tickets.title: A meal I ate, opened from the Plan: what Put it on the Plate again means
tickets.why: Coach Milan 18 November 20:04: in the Plan he opened the What you ate card Chicken and sweet potato fries, tapped Put it on the Plate again. The foods landed right. The title was grey though the meal was saved; Meal and day were not set though it was saved as a meal. His question: is this that meal again, so a change on the Plate changes it (an edit), or a new meal that does not touch the old one (save as)? It has to be clear to everyone. As built (src/components/PastMeal.tsx, again): a copy of the foods only, no name, no photo, no meal, no link to the eaten meal; the eaten meal is edited by Change it on the same page (DT284). It also replaces a plate that has foods with no question (a way DT313 missed). Proposed to him: it stays a copy, a new plate; the button and one line say so; the name comes along; a plate with foods is asked first. Waits for his word on the meaning, then a board.
